remarks: Cozy 3rd-floor apartment located in desirable Harbor Shores! Enjoy clear views of Long Island Sound and Sheffield Island from both the living room and private balcony. The unit features an updated kitchen with a dishwasher and a spacious walk-in closet offering plenty of storage. Situated on a quiet dead-end street, with easy water access at the end of the road-perfect for kayaking or paddleboarding during the summer months. Off-street parking available for two cars. Conveniently located just a stones throw away from the park with pickleball & tennis courts. Commuter-friendly location: only a 5-minute drive to the train station. Vibrant Washington Street, with its restaurants and shops, is just a 5-minute drive away. Not to forget minutes away from Calf Pasture Beach!  No pets. Applicants must have strong credit, proof of employment, references, and no prior evictions or criminal history.
